ownershipRules: Neuro-Kurisu owns runtime state, cognition loop, memory, goals, world model, embodiment state and persistence.
The browser never instantiates a second organism brain.
Live2D and legacy sprite engines are rendering surfaces only.
Research branches cannot auto-promote code into the canonical runtime.
Near-duplicate functions require a single owner plus adapters; no parallel writable state.
Legacy snapshots remain immutable reference material.
MemoryOS2 is the only writable canonical memory owner; source branches and Hexis are adapters/projections, and external evidence is hypothesis-only with bounded independent-lineage provenance.
Historical expanded WILL and Neuro-Kurisu 35.30 trees are reproducibly materialized from retained SHA-256-verified source archives; exact duplicate Lumina/Letta archive aliases are not stored twice.

WorkPass37 routes keyed external actions through the canonical ActionGateway receipt ledger; verified postconditions use the shared ExternalObserverFabric and only exact host-supplied decision IDs can enter temporal credit/reafference.
The optional llama.cpp chat adapter is local-loopback only, configured through LLAMA_CPP_URL/LLAMA_CPP_MODEL, and never owns cognition, memory or model weights.

WorkPass43 routes autonomous tool execution through OrganismCore.executeTool and ActionGateway durable receipts; receipt projection is keyed by executionId, replay-safe within the bounded causal ring, and external evidence cannot be attributed by tool name alone.

WorkPass46 makes the active app Live2D viewer deterministic and offline-first: it uses only release-vendored Pixi/Cubism scripts; a missing local asset is surfaced instead of loading unpinned remote code, and Legacy remains the visual fallback.

WorkPass48 builds autonomous dialogue candidates from active goals and eligible consolidated pattern/goal-learning/self-model memories, connects the existing affect appraisal to a bounded tone hint, suppresses near-duplicate topics for 14 days, and never treats UI delivery ACK as evidence of reciprocity.

WorkPass50 unifies endogenous topic selection across the canonical P33 graded-interest profile, active goals, evidence-backed memories, self-authored goals, temporary affect and explicit thread-linked response feedback. Actual user text—not sensor-only cycles—owns the social quiet timer. A real OrganismRuntime background-clock regression reaches the configured provider seam, stages an initiative, confirms UI delivery, persists learning and restores without redelivery. The avatar adds opt-in browser speech and approximate word-boundary mouth shaping; browser/device E2E remains unverified.

WorkPass51 fixes temporal credit attribution to exact decisionId, explicitly expires overflowed unresolved decisions with zero eligibility, requires independent Reafference support with corroborated reconciliation, persists verified external outcome episodes through the single MemoryOS2 owner and updates P33 idempotently; intent-aware retrieval remains unpromoted because broad recallDelta=0.

WorkPass54 adds an app-wide in-tab action approval continuation: protected API calls suspend on ActionGateway challenge, show only the redacted server preview, resolve through the single permission owner, and retry the captured JSON request once. Runtime Atlas is read-only for approval decisions to prevent cross-panel ticket races; no sensitive request body is persisted in browser storage.

WorkPass66 fixes canonical dual-lockfile installation, runtime pinned-TypeScript selection, and aligns the embedded ReleaseContract and integration manifest to the current runtime release; these changes do not certify a live provider/device or UI E2E.

WorkPass68 routes physical TTS through the canonical ActionGateway using stable speechEventId/idempotency keys; post-start timeout or failure is ambiguous and remains pending for reconciliation rather than being credited as no-effect or learned as failure. Process completion alone is not independent playback verification; live Android E2E remains open.
integrationGuarantees: Canonical runtime is the only writable organism state owner.
UI consumes canonical runtime snapshots over HTTP and does not instantiate the legacy organism.
Live2D and legacy sprites are asset-backed renderers with honest unavailable states; no procedural avatar fallback is shipped.
Research branches are read-only qualification surfaces exposed through research/research_bridge.py.
Legacy branches and exact input archives are preserved as immutable provenance, outside active ownership.
Generated runtime state and dependency directories are excluded from release artifacts.
Selected WILL mechanisms are adapter-bound and persisted inside the canonical runtime; no second organism owner is introduced.
Lumina-derived product adapters are canonical-adapter only: exact search, capability policy, idempotency and channel/voice/browser seams do not create competing state owners.
Letta-derived source-boundary, telemetry and artifact-review governance is adapter-only; no retired Letta runtime is imported.
ContextBudgetLedger is owned by LanguageOrgan; dynamic prompt truncation/omission is recorded as hashed receipts and does not create a second memory store.
PortableSubjectFidelity is a read-only diagnostic over the canonical portable-subject contract; fidelity status is not a behavioral-equivalence claim.

AdaptiveMemoryStrategyReadout is an evidence-gated advisory adapter into PolicyAuthorityLedger; per-action influence is capped at ±0.03 and strategy state is persisted via canonical organism migrations.
NeuroCore V143 benchmark outputs are portable and resolve from the project root or NK_NEUROCORE_V143_OUTPUT_DIR, not a hard-coded workstation path.
Backup/restore wrappers share a hash-verified state helper; restore requires explicit confirmation and refuses a live runtime lock.
Memo-derived content identity remains a canonical MemoryOS2 primitive; explicit revision IDs are scoped to the existing temporal lineage and do not introduce another memory store.
Hexis temporal lookup/diff delegates to canonical MemoryOS2 validity windows; Hexis temporal assertions are derived audit/export projections only.
Default Hexis learning reviews select bounded recent, valid and non-quarantined canonical memories; historical records remain accessible through explicit IDs and temporal inspection.

Canonical MemoryOS2 items retain a byte-bounded independent evidence trail (up to eight visible lineages plus a bounded 32-key replay guard); external research uses EvidenceFirewall-derived source lineage, so syndicated mirrors do not count as separate votes and provenance does not create a second memory owner.
MemoryOS2 hybrid retrieval combines BM25, token coverage, typo-tolerant character-trigram matches, entities and graph/temporal signals; hashed token projections are not ranked as semantic embeddings.
WorkPass35 applies bounded WILL agency scores before canonical P69 arbitration; P69 retains final choice/veto ownership and WILL diagnostics preserve baseline plus actual delta.
Embedded ReleaseContract version and schema match the canonical runtime package and activeRuntime manifest; schema migrations normalize older supported state snapshots to the current schema.

ActionGateway idempotency receipts persist pending before side effects; duplicate/conflicting requests, post-action finalization failures, and missing output schemas fail closed. Exact host-supplied decision IDs plus independently configured external source/postcondition evidence are required for temporal credit.

WorkPass40 restore takes the runtime maintenance lock atomically; restore stages and checksums supported state files and rolls back partial commits. The local llama.cpp adapter uses the existing model-ecology owner and configured local OpenAI-compatible HTTP surface.

Unified cognitive-cycle completion is verified against its own six stage IDs, same-tick ownership and required causal edges; old ring-buffer dangling parents cannot validate or invalidate a cycle by themselves.

Canonical MemoryRetentionEconomy uses net retention value, harm/redundancy and provenance for admission even without byte pressure; the byte-budget blend is an additional constraint, not the only path for cost/harm.

The active app Live2D viewer does not fall back to remote CDN script execution; the vendored local runtime is the sole script source, and a missing dependency surfaces the existing unavailable/Legacy fallback path.

WorkPass66 requires the canonical installer to validate and run both committed lockfiles; runtime typecheck prefers the app lockfile-pinned TypeScript, and all release owner manifests must match VERSION.json and ReleaseContract.

WorkPass67 removes the unused @hookform/resolvers dependency and its orphaned package subtree after active-source verification; the app manifest, lockfile root, SBOM and source provenance are checked together. No dependency-complete build is claimed while the registry is unreachable.

WorkPass67 enforces install deadlines by terminating the npm process group (TERM then KILL) and returns fail-fast without orphaning lifecycle descendants; the hanging-child regression is POSIX-verified. Networked package installation remains required before production build sign-off.

WorkPass68 routes EmbodimentRuntime speech through OrganismCore.executeTool and ActionGateway; Termux TTS outcomes distinguish completed, not-started and unknown. Ambiguous outcomes do not increase embodiment failure streak, cooldown or reliability penalty, and do not trigger blind retry. A successful command receipt is not claimed as independent playback verification.

workpass70.contract: contracts/embodiment-intent.v1.schema.json; one versioned kurisu_embodiment_intent envelope transports speech identity/clock/phase, mouth viseme, face expression, gaze, body pose/motion, priority and cancellation token.
workpass70.owner: app/src/components/AvatarStage.tsx is the sole browser speech timeline publisher; app/public/live2d/viewer.html accepts the single typed, stateVersion-gated control contract.
workpass70.timing: One monotonic speech-audio clock drives both published audioTimeMs and viseme timeline sampling. SpeechSynthesis UTF-16 charIndex boundaries re-anchor the text mapping; elapsedTime contributes an additional anchor when available, while the clock high-water mark never rewinds and stale/out-of-order boundaries are rejected.
workpass70.cancellation: Utterance identity guards suppress stale onstart/onboundary/onend/onerror callbacks; cancelled state carries cancel:<speechEventId> token and viewer closes the mouth immediately. Iframe remount handshake resends the latest state.
workpass70.verification: Nine targeted timeline/viewer-handler tests, 227 app-script tests, runtime typecheck, viewer JS syntax, release metadata and runtime contract/integrity/source checks pass. The production viewer message handler is exercised in an isolated VM with stubbed DOM/model methods, not in a browser renderer.
